items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Tonic Tribe. ... Tang Heys, Part 1, Part 2. I had one number there with a 52 bar layout before I come in on it.

ctx.x: Tonic Tribe. Tonic Tribe. Yeah, like going home and all them big marches, Tang Heys, Part 1, Part 2. I had one number there with a 52 bar layout before I come in on it. You know that. You know that. 52 bar layout? 52 bar before I'd done anything. Yeah. Yeah, but when I'd come in, I'd be right ready. I'd be right ready.
Was that the band that rehearsed over at the Tulane Club? No, but we had-
